verdict.rationale: New Relic explicitly supports instrumenting via OpenTelemetry with platform-agnostic ingestion, explicitly marketing 'gain platform-agnostic observability' and integrating OTel data with full platform capabilities (dashboards, alerts, NRQL), which directly matches the story of instrumenting once with open standards and not being locked to a single backend's proprietary agent format. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of switching backends away from New Relic after OTel instrumentation, and no detail on OTLP endpoint compatibility specifics or vendor lock-in caveats.
